subject: general
question: Ajit Kumar Mohanty took over the charge of Chairman, _____, in May 2023.

options.text: National Human Rights Commission of India

solution:
The correct answer is __**Atomic Energy Commission**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ajit Kumar Mohanty** took over the charge of Chairman, **Atomic Energy Commission** in May 2023.
 
• The Atomic Energy Commission is responsible for the administration of the Atomic Energy Act, 1962, and it oversees the development and implementation of policies related to atomic energy in India.
 
• It plays a critical role in the planning and execution of nuclear power projects and research in the field of nuclear science and technology.
 
• The commission ensures the safe and secure use of nuclear energy for peaceful purposes, such as power generation, medical applications, and scientific research.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Atomic Energy Commission** was established in 1948 to spearhead India's nuclear program.
 
• It functions under the Department of Atomic Energy, which is directly under the Prime Minister of India.
 
• The commission has been instrumental in the establishment of several nuclear power plants and research facilities across the country.
 
• It also collaborates with international organizations to promote the peaceful use of nuclear energy and to ensure adherence to global safety standards.
 
• India is committed to using nuclear energy as a means to achieve energy security and to reduce carbon emissions in line with its climate goals.
